data.exact_reserve_text: The run-off deterioration for Syndicate 1919 relating to prior year's business was GBP 12.5m. This was mainly due to the Accident & Health class which saw an increase in exposure in the 2013 underwriting year, with relatively poor associated attritional loss experience.

prior_year_events.event_name: Run-off deterioration relating to prior years
prior_year_events.impact_description: Run-off deterioration of GBP 12.5m mainly due to Accident & Health increase in exposure in the 2013 underwriting year and poor attritional loss experience

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2014 Syndicate 1919 reported a prior-year run-off deterioration of GBP 12.5m (strengthening of reserves), primarily driven by adverse development in Accident & Health related to increased exposure in the 2013 underwriting year and poorer-than-expected attritional claim experience. Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 439.819m. Other lines showed mixed experience but no quantified prior-year gross movements were disclosed.
raw_causal_phrases: The run-off deterioration for Syndicate 1919 relating to prior year's business was GBP 12.5m.
This was mainly due to the Accident & Health class which saw an increase in exposure in the 2013 underwriting year, with relatively poor associated attritional loss experience.
The A&H class was affected by the deterioration on one account that was written in 2013.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (GBP 12.5m) is taken from narrative text describing a 'run-off deterioration' and is assumed to be a gross (insurance liabilities) amount; no explicit movement table with separate insurance liabilities / reinsurer's share columns was provided in the extracted text. Many LOB impacts are described qualitatively and not quantified; allocations of the GBP 12.5m to Accident & Health are described as 'mainly due to' A&H but not explicitly apportioned.
